slides.say: By default, if your app throws an error during rendering, React removes its UI from the screen. Error Boundaries prevent that.
Wrap part of your tree. If Profile or any child throws while rendering, the boundary shows the fallback instead of that part.

slides.text: Built as a class with static getDerivedStateFromError (+ optional componentDidCatch to log).
slides.say: An Error Boundary is a class component with get derived state from error. Optionally add component did catch to log the error.

slides.text: No function-component version yet. Libraries like react-error-boundary help. Don’t wrap every avatar.
slides.say: There is no function component version yet, but you can use a library like react error boundary. Place boundaries where an error message makes sense, not around every avatar.
